positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Full stack development for eCommerce solutions using .NET 9 and Angular 15 hosted on Azure Cloud.
● Led Azure disaster recovery documentation initiative, collaborating with vendors and contractors.
● Improved Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, increasing deployment reliability and speed.
● Modernized 25%-30% of the legacy AngularJS app to Angular 15 framework.
● Managed biweekly production releases and non-production deployments.
● Oversaw pull request assignments, status tracking, and merging coordination.
● Participated in Agile meetings and ceremonies.
● Mentored junior engineers in technical skills and best practices.
